investigation_report.investigation_summary: Cost-price discrepancies were investigated in BUS UAT for test products MC395379T1 and ML351505. MC395379T1 had a manually updated cost price in Bus Price Master Staging that differed from Realtime Staging Master. ML351505 had a NULL Price Group, causing its Realtime Staging Master Cost Price to remain aligned with Bus Price Master Staging; the Price Group was updated and the record reprocessed.
important_findings: For product MC395379T1, the cost price in Bus Price Master Staging was manually updated for testing and differed from Realtime Staging Master.
For product ML351505 in BUS UAT, the Price Group was NULL.
The NULL Price Group caused the Cost Price in Realtime Staging Master for ML351505 to remain the same as the value in Bus Price Master Staging.
The Bus Price Master Staging cost price for MC395379T1 was corrected and the record was reprocessed.
The Price Group for ML351505 was updated and the Bus Price Master Staging record was reprocessed.
investigation_report.root_cause: Manual cost-price modification in Bus Price Master Staging for MC395379T1 and a NULL Price Group for ML351505 in BUS UAT.
investigation_report.resolution: Corrected the cost price for MC395379T1 in Bus Price Master Staging and reprocessed the record; updated the Price Group for ML351505 and reprocessed its Bus Price Master Staging record.

investigation_report.investigation_summary: Users could not select model codes while creating quotes, stopping quotation operations. Investigation confirmed that the Catalog File was not imported and that the Model Code and Catalog files were not executed in the correct order. This left model codes unassociated with the Body Type selected in the quote, preventing their display; recovery was completed and models became selectable.
important_findings: Model codes on the quotation screen are displayed based on the Body Type selected in the quote.
The Catalog File was not imported into the system.
The Model Code and Catalog files were not executed in the correct order.
Because of the incorrect execution order, model codes were not configured with the Body Type selected in the quote.
The issue was caused by a work error during the file-loading process.
Recovery was completed and models became available for selection.
investigation_report.root_cause: The Catalog File was not imported and the Model Code and Catalog files were executed in the wrong order, leaving model codes unassociated with the selected Body Type.
investigation_report.resolution: Completed recovery by correcting the file-loading/execution process so that models became available for selection; planned automation and streamlining of catalog-file imports as a preventive measure.

Thank you for your support.
We have fixed the initial approval error pop-up message for all the UV entities. Now the approval history is not created for UV Purchase Quote and UV Sales Order because during approval flow creation the Sales Rep Position of these entities are checked.
For the transactional UV data of UV Purchase Quote & UV Sales Order, we have updated the Sales Rep Position in the BUS FORCE according to the position mapping provided by business. Currently for these records the SC Position was mapped to Dummy Branch User Position and hence these Dummy Positions are not getting processed in Approval Flow Logic.
In such cases, we can either update the BUS Positions for UV Purchase Quote & UV Sales Order or else we can add Dummy Position in UV Purchase Quote & UV Sales Order Approval Flows.

investigation_report.investigation_summary: The initial approval error pop-up message was fixed for all UV entities. Approval history was still not created for UV Purchase Quote and UV Sales Order because approval-flow creation evaluates the Sales Rep Position, and the affected records were mapped to dummy BUS positions that are not processed by Approval Flow Logic. Proposed corrective options were to update the BUS Positions or add the dummy positions to the relevant approval flows.
important_findings: The initial approval error pop-up message was fixed for all UV entities.
Approval history was not created for UV Purchase Quote and UV Sales Order.
Approval-flow creation checks the Sales Rep Position of the transactional entities.
The affected SC Positions were mapped to Dummy Branch User Position values in BUS FORCE, which are not processed by Approval Flow Logic.
UV Purchase Quote 1-AAE27ZI was mapped from SC Position Branch Sales Staff HAOYANA to BUS Position Dummy_AY.
UV Sales Order E045288740 was mapped from SC Position Branch Sales Staff_WB_0013 to BUS Position Dummy_WY.
investigation_report.root_cause: The Sales Rep Position mappings in BUS FORCE assigned affected UV Purchase Quote and UV Sales Order records to dummy BUS positions, and those dummy positions were not processed by Approval Flow Logic.

Thank you for your support.
We would like to share the analysis details for the incident MFTBCFFR-6075, related to latest quote revision not reflected in SO.
Please find the summary below:
|­­インシデント番号|MFTBCFFR-6075|
|事象|最新の見積改訂内容が受注に反映されない。|
|RCA|調査の結果、受注は販売見積改訂 4までは正常に同期されていることを確認しました。
その後の最新改訂との同期処理中に、ユーザーが受注を更新したため、同期処理が停止されました。
その際、バックエンドには以下のエラーが出力されていました。
「ステップ 'Sync Sales Order' のサービス 'EAI Siebel Adapter'、 メソッド 'Synchronize' を実行中にエラーが発生しました。(SBL-BPR-00162) ビジネスコンポーネント 'MF RF Order Entry - Line Items' (統合コンポーネント 'MF Order Item') のメソッド 'WriteRecord' で、検索条件が ' = "30"' のレコードが次のエラーを返しました : "選択されたデータは、取得後に他のユーザにより変更されました。そのまま続けてください。(SBL-DAT-00523)"(SBL-EAI-04451)」
データベースを確認したところ、**明細 30（追加架装‐Additional Body）**を除くすべての明細は、Siebel スクリプトにより同一時刻に更新されており、正常に同期処理が実行されていることを確認しました。
 
一方、明細 30（追加架装‐Additional Body）については、最終更新ソースおよび最終更新日が他の明細と異なっており、更新元がSiebel スクリプトではなく、アプリケーションユーザーとなっていました。また、この明細はバックエンドのCX_EAI_LOGSにも記録されていました。
 
以上より、同期処理中にユーザーが追加架装の明細を手動で更新したため、Siebelが他ユーザーによる更新を検知し、同期処理を停止したことが原因と判断しております。
 
その結果、最新の見積改訂内容が受注へ反映されませんでした。
 
 |
|復旧状況|対象データのリカバリーは完了しております。
 
お手数ですが、ご確認をお願いいたします。|
|対応方針（Fix Plan）|バックエンドログからも、同期処理中にユーザーが同じレコードを更新したことが原因であることを確認しております。
 
本事象は、ユーザーが同時に複数の操作を行った場合にのみ発生する非常に稀なケースです。
 
現在はシステムは正常に動作しており、UAT環境でも正常動作を確認しております。そのため、システム改修は不要と判断しております。|
(English)
|­­Incident Number|MFTBCFFR-6075|
|Description|Latest quote revision not reflected in SO|
|Root Cause (RCA)|We investigated this issue and observed that the Sales Order was last successfully synced with the Sales Quote Revision number 4. The sync process for the latest quote revision stopped because the Sales Order was modified while the quote synchronization was in progress.
As a result, the following error was logged at the backend:
"ステップ 'Sync Sales Order' のサービス 'EAI Siebel Adapter'、 メソッド 'Synchronize' を実行中にエラーが発生しました。(SBL-BPR-00162)
ビジネスコンポーネント 'MF RF Order Entry - Line Items' (統合コンポーネント 'MF Order Item') のメソッド 'WriteRecord' で、検索条件が ' = "30"' のレコードが次のエラーを返しました : "選択されたデータは、取得後に他のユーザにより変更されました。そのまま続けてください。(SBL-DAT-00523)"(SBL-EAI-04451)
From the database, we observed that all line items except *Line Number 30 (Additional Body)* were updated by the*Siebel Script* as part of the normal quote synchronization process. The*Last Updated* timestamp for these line items is also the same, confirming that the synchronization completed successfully for them.
However, for *Line Number 30 (Additional Body)*, both the *Last Updated Source* and the *Last Updated* timestamp are different from the other line items. Instead of showing the*Siebel Script* , it shows the application user who manually updated the record. The same line item is also referenced in the *CX_EAI_LOGS* backend error log.
This confirms that the Additional Body line item was manually modified by the user while the quote synchronization was in progress. Since the same record was updated during synchronization, Siebel detected that the record had been modified by another user and stopped the synchronization process, resulting in the*SBL-DAT-00523* error. Therefore, the latest quote revision was not reflected in the Sales Order.
\\
|
|Recovery status|The recovery has been completed for the affected record. Kindly verify.|
|Fix Plan|Our backend error logging clearly mentions that record was simultaneously modified by another user. It is a very rare occurrence where user performs two operations at the same time.
Currently the process is working fine, which can be tested on UAT as well. No fix required.|

Please continue. (SBL-DAT-00523)"(SBL-EAI-04451)"

Currently, the system is operating normally, and we have confirmed that it operates normally in the UAT environment. Therefore, we have determined that system modification is not necessary. |

From the database, we observed that all line items except *Line Number 30 (Additional Body)* were updated by the*Siebel Script* as part of the normal quote synchronization process. The*Last Updated* timestamp for these line items is also the same, confirming that the synchronization completed successfully for them.
However, for *Line Number 30 (Additional Body)*, both the *Last Updated Source* and the *Last Updated* timestamp are different from the other line items. Instead of showing the*Siebel Script* , it shows the application user who manually updated the record. The same line item is also referenced in the *CX_EAI_LOGS* backend error log.
This confirms that the Additional Body line item was manually modified by the user while the quote synchronization was in progress. Since the same record was updated during synchronization, Siebel detected that the record had been modified by another user and stopped the synchronization process, resulting in the*SBL-DAT-00523* error. Therefore, the latest quote revision was not reflected in the Sales Order.
\\
|
|Recovery status|The recovery has been completed for the affected record. Kindly verify.|

investigation_report.investigation_summary: The latest Sales Quote revision was not reflected in the Sales Order because quote synchronization stopped during processing. The Sales Order had synchronized successfully through Sales Quote Revision 4, but a concurrent manual update to Line Number 30 (Additional Body) caused a Siebel record-concurrency error. The affected data was recovered, and normal operation was confirmed in UAT; no system modification was required.
important_findings: Sales Order synchronization completed successfully through Sales Quote Revision 4.
The Sync Sales Order step failed in EAI Siebel Adapter > Synchronize while writing MF RF Order Entry - Line Items / MF Order Item record 30.
The backend logged SBL-DAT-00523, indicating the selected record was modified by another user after retrieval, along with SBL-BPR-00162 and SBL-EAI-04451.
All line items except Line Number 30 (Additional Body) were updated at the same time by Siebel Script, confirming normal synchronization for those items.
Line Number 30 (Additional Body) had a different Last Updated Source and Last Updated timestamp, showing an application-user update; it was also recorded in CX_EAI_LOGS.
Recovery of the affected record was completed, and the process operated normally in UAT.
investigation_report.root_cause: A user manually updated Sales Order Line Number 30 (Additional Body) while the latest Sales Quote synchronization was in progress. Siebel detected the concurrent record change and stopped synchronization with SBL-DAT-00523.
investigation_report.resolution: Recovered the affected record. No system fix was implemented because the issue was identified as a rare concurrent-user-operation scenario and normal operation was confirmed in UAT.

HelloThank you for your support.
As per your concern, please find our analysis below.
In the BUS UAT environment, we have two types of labor price lists:
# *SC Price List* — for example, *FDP B Price List*
# *Branch Price List* — specific to individual branches
The price list is picked while creating line items in the Work Order based on the below conditions.
The *Branch Price List* will be picked only when both of the following conditions are satisfied:
# *Billing Type* should be one of the below values:
{noformat}Shaken
3mon Inspection
6mon Inspection
12mon Inspection
24mon Inspection
Completion inspection fee
Shaken Agency fee
MPC Shaken
PDF Shaken
MPC+PDF Shaken
Spare Tire-Toolbox
OBD Inspection{noformat}
# *Discount Classification* should not be blank, as shown in the attached screenshot. 
The Discount Classification value comes from the Vehicle/Chassis record. Therefore, kindly create the Job Card for a Vehicle/Chassis where Discount Classification is available.
If above conditions are not true, the system will always pick the *SC Price List* as default, that is, the *FDP Price List*, instead of the Branch Price List.
The Job Card *I050000511* that you were testing was created against a Chassis/Vehicle where *Discount Classification* is blank. Because of this, the system picked the *SC Price List* by default, that is, the *FDP Price List*, instead of the *Branch Price List*.
Kindly validate the above and let us know if you have any further concerns or queries.

investigation_report.investigation_summary: Job Cards were assigning incorrect labor price lists for their creation branch. In BUS UAT, Branch Price List selection depends on the Billing Type and a non-blank Discount Classification from the Vehicle/Chassis; otherwise the system defaults to an SC Price List such as FDP B Price List. The price list setup was corrected, and newly created Job Cards correctly selected the applicable Branch Price List; existing Job Cards retained the previously stamped Branch Labor Price List Id.
important_findings: Branch Price List is selected only when Billing Type is an eligible inspection-related value and Discount Classification is populated.
Discount Classification is sourced from the Vehicle/Chassis record.
When the selection conditions are not met, the system defaults to the SC Price List, including FDP Price List/FDP B Price List.
Job Card I050000511 used a Vehicle/Chassis with blank Discount Classification, causing FDP B Price List to be selected.
Existing Job Cards created before the price list setup correction retain the old Branch Labor Price List Id, including for newly added labor line items.
A newly created Job Card correctly selected Branch GY Price List after the setup update.
investigation_report.root_cause: The price list setup contained an incorrect Branch Labor Price List configuration; Job Cards created before the correction had the old/wrong Branch Labor Price List Id stamped on them. Additionally, blank Discount Classification causes the expected fallback to the SC/FDP Price List rather than a Branch Price List.
investigation_report.resolution: Updated the price list setup and validated that newly created Job Cards select the correct branch-specific price list, including Branch GY Price List. Existing Job Cards must be replaced with newly created Job Cards to use the corrected stamped price list.

investigation_report.investigation_summary: The New car / NV incident covered multiple configuration, data, workflow, and BIP report-output defects. Direct option entry, part-number filtering, recycling-fee detail generation, registration-fee amounts, and several quotation/order-form report issues were corrected or validated. However, the final status still listed unresolved defects, including Purchase Plan configuration, recycling-fee labeling, quotation report formatting, approval navigation, mapping, and downstream workflow issues.
important_findings: Direct option entry failed because the option price was not fetched from VC; after the fix, the option price was fetched correctly and no error was displayed.
Additional part-number options appeared because the filter had been removed for a CR requirement; correcting the filter logic restricted the selection.

Recycling Fee and taxable/non-taxable registration-fee details were created after Vehicle Classification was aligned with the Recycle Fee Master and Add Taxes & Expenses was used; the registration-fee amount display was subsequently fixed.

Purchase Plan Master records were missing for HB, LB, and MB compared with SC PROD. Temporary records allowed Purchase Plan PDF generation, but were reverted pending confirmation of the required product-class scope.
Purchase Plan PDF generation requires Purchase Plan Generation = Y on the NV Quote screen; the flag becomes Y when MF Sales Profit >= MF First Profit Amount.

Order-form address data was missing because relevant transaction data was NULL on the SC side; a data patch for NV Transactional Migration records in BUS restored address retrieval in Order Sheet BIP's.

comments.author: Atul Yadav
comments.text:
角田さん
いつもお世話になっております。
 
本件につきまして、調査結果をご報告いたします。
【原因】：影響を受けた全レコードを調査した結果、SC環境から中国環境へのデータ移行時に移行されたデータであることを確認いたしました。
移行作業では大部分のレコードは正常に取り込まれておりましたが、一部のレコードに問題が発生したため、初回移行から約20日後に再パッチを実施しております。
この再パッチの際に住所情報のIDが誤って移行されたことが原因で、現在確認されている住所不一致が発生いたしました。
【リカバリ】：これまでご共有していた対象レコードにつきましては、すべてリカバリ作業を完了しております。
また、その他の本番環境についても確認を実施した結果、同様の事象は発生していないことを確認しております。
【恒久対策】：今後は、データ移行作業時の検証を強化し、同様のデータ不整合が発生しないよう再発防止に努めてまいります。
なお、本件コード関係問題ではなく、システム改修は不要と判断しております。
つきましては、本インシデントをクローズさせていただきたく、ご承認をお願いいたします。
 
ご不明点や追加で必要な情報がございましたら、お知らせください。
何卒よろしくお願いいたします。
English:
Thank you for your support and cooperation.
*Root Cause:* We investigated all the affected records and confirmed that they were migrated to the Chugoku environment from the SC environment.
During the migration activity, most of the records were imported successfully. However, due to an issue with a few records, they had to be re-patched approximately 20 days after the initial migration.
This re-patching caused this issue and in the IDs of the address entries was migrated incorrectly, which is the reason for the address mismatches that we are observing.
*Recovery:* We have completed the recovery for all the records that were previously shared. In addition, we thoroughly checked all other production environments and found no similar issues.
*Countermeasure:* Going forward, we will perform additional verification for all data migration activities to ensure that such inconsistencies do not occur again.
Since this is not a code-related issue and no system fix is required, we would like to request your approval to close this incident.
Please let us know if you have any questions or require any additional information.
Regards,
Atul Yadav

investigation_report.investigation_summary: The blank expense calculation sheet behavior was investigated and determined to be expected system configuration, not a defect. The implemented logic generates expense calculation sheet data from an Invoice only when the associated Order Amount is greater than 0. The behavior was replicated in FDP UAT using UV Sales Orders with zero and positive amounts.
important_findings: Expense calculation sheet generation from Invoice requires Order Amount to be greater than 0 for report data to be populated.
An Order Amount of 0 generates a blank expense calculation sheet.

UV Sales Order E001305081 had Amount = 0.

investigation_report.root_cause: Configured logic only populates the expense calculation sheet when the Invoice's associated Order Amount is greater than 0; zero-value orders produce a blank report.
investigation_report.resolution: No code fix was required; the incident was classified as system configuration/expected behavior and proposed for rejection.

comments.text:
Dear Shiromoto san
Thank you for your support.
We would like to share the analysis details for the incident MFTBCFFR-6022, related to latest quote revision not reflected in Sales Order.
Please find the summary below:
|Incident Number |MFTBCFFR-6022|
|Description|The latest quote revision is not reflected in Sales Order.|
|Root Cause (RCA)|We have investigated this issue and observed that the user created the first quote revision using model code 'FBAV0B22S00G-4'. After completing the quote, user proceeded to create the corresponding sales order from this quote.
After that user revised the sales quote and in second revision, the user deleted the line item having model code as 'FBAV0B22S00G-4' and created a new quote line item in quote items using a different Model Code 'FBAV0B22S00G-4-G830'.
When user completed the sales quote revision 2 and attempted to synchronize the sales quote with the Sales Order, the line number reference for original quote line item had been lost and the synchronization process could not be completed.
However the user continued to revise the quote upto revision number 5, but the sales order remained in synchronized only with revision 1. 
For the recovery, we updated the line number of the new created quote line item with Model Code as 'FBAV0B22S00G-4-G830' to match the line number of the previously created item. After this update, the Sales Order was successfully synchronized with the latest quote revision.
To avoid this issue, users are advised to update the Model Code on the existing quote line item instead of deleting the entire line item and creating a new one. This preserves the line number reference required for successful synchronization.
Since this is a case of user misoperation, no fix is required.|
|Recovery status|Recovery has been completed.|
|Fix Plan|Since this issue occurred due to user misoperation, no system fix is required.|
If you require further clarification or assistance, please feel free to reach out.
Regards
Sunaina Gill

investigation_report.investigation_summary: The latest Sales Quote revisions were not reflected in the Sales Order after the original quote line was deleted and replaced with a new line using a different Model Code. Deleting the original line removed the line-number reference required by the quote-to-Sales Order synchronization. The new quote line's line number was updated to match the original line, and the Sales Order then synchronized successfully with the latest quote revision.
important_findings: The initial quote used Model Code 'FBAV0B22S00G-4', and the Sales Order was created from that quote.
In quote revision 2, the original line item was deleted and replaced with a new line using Model Code 'FBAV0B22S00G-4-G830'.
Deleting the original quote line caused the original line-number reference to be lost, preventing Sales Quote synchronization with the Sales Order.
The Sales Order remained synchronized only through revision 1 despite subsequent quote revisions up to revision 5.
Updating the replacement quote line's line number to match the original line restored synchronization with the latest quote revision.
Users should update the Model Code on an existing quote line instead of deleting and recreating the line.
investigation_report.root_cause: User deleted the original quote line item and created a replacement line with a different Model Code, which removed the line-number reference required to synchronize the Sales Quote with the Sales Order.
investigation_report.resolution: Updated the line number of the quote line with Model Code 'FBAV0B22S00G-4-G830' to match the previously created quote line; the Sales Order then synchronized with the latest quote revision. No system fix was required.

investigation_report.investigation_summary: Migration validation identified mismatched record counts and non-bus data in Bus Force/BUS UAT across NV Opportunities, NV Quotes, NV Sales orders, Chassis Orders, and Body Orders. The migration logic included NV Opportunities when at least one related entity had a bus product class, which could include associated truck data. A confirmed mapping defect caused SC name and Branch Name values to be reversed or displayed incorrectly; Branch Mapping and SC-level mapping were corrected, while several other migration defects remained under investigation.
important_findings: Bus migration criteria included records where NV Opportunity, NV Quote, Vehicle, or Model Code contained a bus product class: HB, MB, LB, 320, 330, or 340.
The migration criteria could include truck-associated data when a related entity contained bus information, resulting in records considered unnecessary for Bus Force validation.
For Daisuke Higuchi records created before 2026/06/01, Bus UAT and SC showed matching counts of 148 NV Opportunities and 318 NV Quote records when equivalent filters were applied.
For Chassis Orders created before 2026/06/01 with product class HB, MB, or LB, SC Force had 9,107 records and Bus Force had 9,051 records; 56 records were not migrated for documented reasons.
The SC name/Branch Name reversal was caused by missing SC-level mapping, preventing correct mapping.
NV Sales order Branch Name information was updated using the revised Branch Mapping; competitor data for new car deals was migrated to BUS UAT.

comments.author: Atul Yadav
comments.text:
-San,
Thank you for your support. 
We have checked this issue and found that the quote was manually set to "Customer Approved" in MFTBCFFR-5819. Therefore the JCO creator was set as "*Siebel Administrator"* instead of regular user.
As a result, the *workshop code* was blank and hence *Department Code(CSJS200)* and *Department Code(CSJS300)* was set as blank. This is the reason the JVs for JC I050809872 & I050809889 were not linked to KB.
*Recovery:* We have completed the recovery and JVs will be linked to KB tonight.
Since this is not a logic issue but a recovery error that is why no fix will be required in this. Therefore, as discussed, please close this incident .
Please let us know in case of any questions.
 
Thanks & Regards,
Atul Yadav

investigation_report.investigation_summary: JVs for JC I050809872 and I050809889 were not linked to KB because the related quote was manually set to "Customer Approved" in MFTBCFFR-5819. This caused the JCO creator to be "Siebel Administrator" rather than a regular user, leaving the workshop code and dependent department codes blank. Recovery was completed and the JVs were scheduled to link to KB that night; no logic fix was required.
important_findings: The quote was manually set to "Customer Approved" in MFTBCFFR-5819.
The JCO creator was set to "Siebel Administrator" instead of a regular user.
The workshop code was blank, causing Department Code(CSJS200) and Department Code(CSJS300) to be blank.
Blank department codes prevented the JVs for JC I050809872 and I050809889 from being linked to KB.
The issue was classified as a recovery error rather than a logic issue.
investigation_report.root_cause: Manual setting of the quote to "Customer Approved" in MFTBCFFR-5819 caused the JCO creator to be "Siebel Administrator", resulting in a blank workshop code and blank Department Code(CSJS200) and Department Code(CSJS300), which prevented JV linkage to KB.
investigation_report.resolution: Recovery was completed; the JVs for JC I050809872 and I050809889 were to be linked to KB that night. No logic fix was required.

Thank you for your support.
We would like to share the analysis details for the incident MFTBCFFR-5966, related to the issue where Recycle Fee Order is not displayed in corresponding Chassis Order.
Please find the summary below:
|Incident Number |MFTBCFFR-5966|
|Description|Recycle Fee Order is not displayed in corresponding Chassis Order.|
|Root Cause (RCA)|We investigated this issue and observed that the D21F file for the creation of the Recycle Fee Order was received from the TOB side before the D21A file for the corresponding Chassis Order. As a result, the D21F file was processed before the D21A file.
Since the corresponding Chassis Order (and therefore the vehicle record) had not yet been created when the D21F file was executed, the system was unable to create the Recycle Fee Order.
Later, when the D21A file was received and processed, the corresponding Chassis Order was created successfully. However, because the D21F file had already been processed, the Recycle Fee Order was not created for this Chassis Order.
For your reference, we have attached the corresponding D21A and D21F files. It can be confirmed from the timestamps that the D21F file was received before the D21A file.
|
|Recovery status|Recovery has been completed.
For recovery, we re-executed the D21F file after the Chassis Order had been created successfully. As a result, the Recycle Fee Order was created successfully and is now correctly displayed in the Chassis Order.|
|Fix Plan|To prevent this issue from occurring again, we will implement a monitoring mechanism that sends an email notification whenever a D21F file is processed before the corresponding vehicle has been created. Upon receiving the notification, we will perform the necessary recovery procedure and inform you the same.
This monitoring mechanism is already implemented and functioning in the SC Production environment. We will apply the same solution to the FDP Production environment as well.|
If you require further clarification or assistance, please feel free to reach out.
Regards
Sunaina Gill

Dear Tsunoda San, 
Thanks for your support. 
Please find below the analysis details for incident *MFTBCFFR: 5966* regarding the issue where the recycle order was not displayed in the Chugoku Production environment.
*Root Cause Analysis (RCA):*
The *D21F* file was received and processed before the *D21A* file. Since the chassis record had not yet been created during the D21A file execution, the recycle fee order could not be created during the D21F execution.
*Recovery Action:*
As part of the recovery, the *D21F* process was re-executed after the successful completion of the *D21A* process. This resulted in the successful creation of the recycle fee order. 
*Countermeasure:*
As this issue was caused by the sequence of *TOB* file processing and is *not related to the Siebel system*, we are unable to provide a Siebel-side countermeasure for this scenario.
 *Monitoring:*
To avoid such errors, Cubastion has configured email notifications to alert the team whenever any file execution fails. This enables us to promptly identify unprocessed or failed files and take timely recovery actions whenever required.
Since this issue was caused by the TOB file processing sequence and is not related to the Siebel system, we would like to proceed with closing this Jira ticket.
Best Regards,
Deepika Raheja

調査の結果、D21FファイルがD21Aファイルより先に受信・処理されていたことを確認しました。
 
D21F処理時点では、D21Aによるシャーシオーダー（車両情報）がまだ作成されていなかったため、リサイクル料オーダーを作成することができませんでした。
 
■ リカバリー対応
 
D21A処理完了後に、D21F処理を再実行した結果、リサイクル料オーダーが正常に作成されることを確認しております。
 
■ 再発防止策
 
本事象は、TOBファイルの処理順序に起因するものであり、Siebelシステムの不具合ではないため、Siebel側で対応可能なシステム改修はございません。
 
なお、同様の事象を早期に検知できるよう、Cubastionではファイル処理に失敗した場合にメール通知を送信する監視機能を導入しております。
 
これにより、処理失敗や未処理ファイルを迅速に検知し、必要に応じて速やかにリカバリー対応を実施できる運用としております。
 
本件はTOBファイルの処理順序に起因する事象であり、Siebelシステムの問題ではないことを確認しておりますので、本JIRAをクローズさせていただきたく存じます。
 
ご不明な点がございましたら、お気軽にお問い合わせください。
 
よろしくお願いいたします。

Dear Tsunoda San,
 
Thank you for your continued support.
 
We would like to report the results of our investigation regarding **incident MFTBCFFR-5966 (recycling fee order not displayed on chassis order in production environment in China)**.
 
■ Cause (RCA)
 
After investigation, we confirmed that the D21F file was received and processed before the D21A file.
 
At the time of D21F processing, a recycling fee order could not be created because the chassis order (vehicle information) by D21A had not yet been created.
 
■ Recovery support
 
We have confirmed that re-running the D21F process after completing the D21A process will successfully create a recycling fee order.
 
■ Measures to prevent recurrence
 
This event is caused by the TOB file processing order and is not a problem with the Siebel system, so there is no system modification that can be done on the Siebel side.
 
Additionally, in order to detect similar events at an early stage, Cubastion has introduced a monitoring function that sends email notifications when file processing fails.
 
This allows us to quickly detect processing failures and unprocessed files, and promptly implement recovery measures if necessary.
 
We have confirmed that this issue is caused by the TOB file processing order and is not a problem with the Siebel system, so we would like to close this JIRA.
 
If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.
 
Thank you for your support.

investigation_report.investigation_summary: The Recycle Fee Order was not displayed in the corresponding Chassis Order because the D21F file was received and processed before the corresponding D21A file from TOB. At D21F processing time, the Chassis Order and vehicle record did not exist, so the Recycle Fee Order could not be created. Recovery was completed by re-executing D21F after D21A completed; however, the requested permanent problem resolution was not accepted, and Jira closure was rejected.
important_findings: D21F was received and processed before the corresponding D21A file, as confirmed by the attached file timestamps.
The Chassis Order and vehicle record had not been created when D21F was processed, preventing creation of the Recycle Fee Order.
Processing D21A later created the Chassis Order, but did not automatically recreate the already missed Recycle Fee Order.
Re-executing D21F after successful D21A processing created the Recycle Fee Order and made it visible in the Chassis Order.
The incident was attributed to TOB file processing sequence rather than a Siebel system defect.
Email monitoring was implemented for FDP Production, but it was characterized as supporting recovery rather than resolving the underlying ordering issue.
investigation_report.root_cause: The TOB D21F file was processed before the corresponding D21A file, so the required Chassis Order and vehicle record did not exist when the Recycle Fee Order creation process ran.
investigation_report.resolution: The affected record was recovered by re-executing the D21F process after successful completion of the D21A process.

investigation_report.investigation_summary: The Branch Manager Name was blank or incorrect in the NV Quotation BIP report for Chugoku Production after logic from MFTBCFFR-5622 was applied. MFTBCFFR-5622 selected a Branch-Head from the Sales Representative's branch organization, which did not meet the required Fuso Chugoku hub-and-spoke behavior. Reverting MFTBCFFR-5622 restored previous behavior but did not satisfy the requested requirement to display the hub branch manager name. The final requested correction and implementation schedule were not provided.
important_findings: MFTBCFFR-5622 logic was applied to all production environments and displayed the Branch-Head based on the branch organization of the Sales Representative at quote creation.
For NV Quote# 2-BUK481, Sales Representative D8HIDMUR had no user with position type "Branch-Head" in the corresponding branch organization, causing the BIP field to be blank.

The required behavior for Fuso Chugoku is to display the hub branch manager name according to the SC hub-and-spoke structure, rather than a fixed personal name or the Sales Representative's branch Branch-Head.
The Branch Manager Name is not obtained from the Employee Master; prior logic displayed a system-configured value based on the branch where the quotation was originally created.
Reverting MFTBCFFR-5622 in FDP UAT-8 and Chugoku Production restored pre-MFTBCFFR-5622 report behavior, but the customer confirmed this was still incorrect.
investigation_report.root_cause: The MFTBCFFR-5622 BIP report logic selected the Branch-Head from the Sales Representative's branch organization, rather than using the required Fuso Chugoku hub-and-spoke mapping to display the hub branch manager name.

Thank you for your continued support.
This issue occurred because the UV Sales Order status was manually updated to *"Approved"*, causing the order to bypass the standard approval process that generates the Trade-in Assessment Purchase Order.
This issue occurred due to a manual status update performed from the backend during a recovery activity for MFTBCFFR-5894. The status change bypassed the normal application process, which led to the unexpected behavior.
*Countermeasure:*
To prevent recurrence, we have updated our recovery SOP. Going forward, all related triggers and dependent processes will be verified at each step before and after performing any backend recovery activity. This will ensure that similar issues do not occur in the future.
The recovery has already been completed successfully, and no application defect or code fix is required for this case.
As discussed, we would like to proceed with closing this incident.
Please let us know if you have any questions or concerns.
Best regards,
Atul Yadav

comments.text:
Dear Yoshihara-San,
Thank you for your support and cooperation.
We have checked the root cause of this incident and following is our analysis:
*Root Cause:*
While implementing the non-repository changes for CR MFTBCFFR-4378, a formatting discrepancy was introduced in the configuration and an extra leading space got added in the logic for the Hakodate and Shikoku production environments. As a result, the component responsible for creating Re-Edit JVs encountered an error, and Re-Edit JVs were not created for the affected records.
*Fix:*
Since this was a non-repository configuration value issue, we corrected the configuration from the backend on the night of 24 June 2026. The *Re-Edit* JV creation has been verified and is now working correctly in both the Shikoku and Hakodate production environments.
Recovery:
We have manually created Re-Edit JVs for all affected records in both the Hakodate and Shikoku production environments. 
*Countermeasure:*
We have added an additional validation step for all non-repository changes as part of the post-production release verification process to ensure such configuration discrepancies are identified before release completion.
Please let us know if you have any queries.
Regards,
Atul Yadav

important_findings: An extra leading space was introduced into configuration logic during non-repository changes for CR MFTBCFFR-4378.
The configuration issue affected the Hakodate and Shikoku production environments.
The component responsible for creating Re-Edit JVs encountered an error, preventing Re-Edit JV creation for affected records.

An additional validation step was added to post-production release verification for non-repository changes.

Dear Tsunoda San,
 
いつもお世話になっております。
 
本件について、調査結果および対応内容をご報告いたします。
 
■ 原因
初回の見積改訂時に、商談台数を3に設定して受注を作成しました。
受注承認後、商談台数に応じて3件の枝番受注が作成されました。
その後、見積を再度改訂し、商談台数を3から1へ変更するとともに、オプションを追加しました。
受注同期時に、追加したオプションは3件すべての枝番受注へ反映されました。
商談台数が1になったため、ユーザーは枝番受注をすべてキャンセルし、親受注の売上計上を実施しました。
しかし、システム上では枝番受注との紐付けが残っていたため、売上計上が失敗しました。
■ 期待される動作
 
商談台数が2以上から1へ変更された場合は、枝番受注との紐付けを自動的に解除し、親受注が正常に売上計上できること。
 
■ 現状の動作
 
現在のバックエンドロジックでは、商談台数が1に変更されても枝番受注との紐付けが解除されません。
そのため、親受注が枝番受注を持つ受注として扱われ、売上計上に失敗していました。
 
■ 対応内容（修正）
 
バックエンドロジックを修正し、商談台数が1になった場合は、枝番受注との紐付けを自動的に解除するよう対応いたします。
これにより、手動対応なしで親受注の売上計上を正常に実施できるようになります。
 
■ テストデータ
UAT-1：NV SO：A001305145
 
ご不明な点がございましたら、お気軽にお問い合わせください。
 
よろしくお願いいたします。
 
(English)
Thank you for your constant support
Root Cause:
During the first quote revision, the user set the Required Quantity to 3 and created the order.
During order approval, 3 child sales orders were created, as expected.
Later, the user revised the quote again and changed the Required Quantity from 3 to 1, while also adding additional options.
During order synchronization, the newly added options were synchronized to all existing child sales orders.
Since the required quantity was now 1, the user cancelled all three child sales orders and attempted to complete the sales posting for the parent sales order.
The sales posting failed because the system still considered the parent sales order to have linked child sales orders.
Expected Behaviour:
When the required quantity is reduced from a value greater than 1 to 1, all child sales orders should automatically be unlinked from the parent sales order. This allows the parent sales order to proceed through the normal sales posting process.
Actual Behaviour:
The existing backend logic did not automatically unlink the child sales orders after the required quantity was reduced to 1. As a result, the parent sales order continued to be treated as a parent with child orders, causing the sales posting process to fail.
Resolution/Fix:
The backend logic will be updated so that whenever the Required Quantity becomes 1, all linked child sales orders are automatically unlinked from the parent sales order. This will ensure the parent sales order can complete the sales posting successfully without requiring manual intervention.
 
Test Data:
UAT-1: NV SO: A001305145
 
Please let us know in case of any other query
 
Best Regards,
Shubham Agarwal

■ Cause
When revising the estimate for the first time, we set the number of units discussed to 3 and created an order.

■ Expected behavior
 
If the number of units negotiated is changed from 2 or more to 1, the linkage with the branch order will be automatically canceled and the parent order will be able to record sales normally.
 
■ Current operation
 
With the current backend logic, even if the number of sales negotiations is changed to 1, the link with the branch number order is not released.
As a result, the parent order was treated as an order with a branch order, and sales failed to be recorded.
 
■ Correspondence details (modifications)
 
We have corrected the backend logic so that when the number of sales reaches 1, the link with the branch number order will be automatically canceled.
This will enable you to successfully record sales for parent orders without any manual action.
 
■ Test data

Thank you for your support.

Dear Tsunoda-San,
 
いつも大変お世話になっております。
 
本件につきまして調査を実施した結果、および対応案をご共有いたします。
調査の結果、FDPでは受注作成後も見積の*商談台数*を変更できる仕様となっているため、本事象が発生することを確認いたしました。
 
今回の事象では、受注作成時に商談台数「3」で枝番受注が3件作成された後、見積改訂により商談台数が「1」に変更されました。その後、すべての枝番受注をキャンセルし、親受注で売上計上を実施したところ、バックエンドでは枝番受注が関連付いていると判断したため、売上計上が失敗しました。
 
SC本番環境では、受注作成後は商談台数が編集不可となるため、このような事象は発生いたしません。一方、FDPでは商談台数の変更が可能なため、SCでは発生しない業務シナリオが実行できる状態となっております。
 
本件の対応方法として、以下の2案を検討しております。
*案1*
商談台数が「1」に変更された場合、親受注と枝番受注の関連付けをバックエンドで自動的に解除するロジックを追加する方法です。
この方法では、現在のFDPの業務フローを維持したまま対応が可能です。
*案2*
FDPをSC本番環境と同じ仕様に変更し、受注作成後は商談台数を編集不可とする方法です。
商談台数を変更する場合は、新しい見積および受注を作成していただく運用となります。
 
SC本番環境と同じ仕様へ統一することで、同様のデータ不整合を防止できるため、弊社としては*案2*を推奨しております。
実装方針を決定するため、FDPについてもSC本番環境と同様に、*受注作成後は商談台数を編集不可とする運用で問題ないか*ご確認いただけますでしょうか。
 
ご参考資料として添付いたしますので、ご確認いただけますと幸いです。
ご確認のほど、よろしくお願いいたします。
 
（English）
Thank you for your continued support.
We would like to share the investigation results and the proposed solution for this issue.
Our investigation confirmed that this issue occurs because FDP currently allows users to modify the *Required Quantity* on the Quote even after a Sales Order has been created.
In the reported case, a Sales Order was initially created with a *Required Quantity of 3*, and the system correctly generated three child Sales Orders. Later, the Quote was revised, and the *Required Quantity was changed from 3 to 1*. After all child Sales Orders were cancelled, the user attempted to perform Sales Posting using the parent Sales Order. However, Sales Posting failed because the backend still recognized the parent Sales Order as being associated with child Sales Orders.
In the SC Production environment, this scenario cannot occur because the *Required Quantity* becomes read-only once a Sales Order has been created. In contrast, FDP currently allows the Required Quantity to be modified after Sales Order creation, enabling a business scenario that is not supported in SC.
We have considered the following two approaches to address this issue.
*Option 1*
Update the backend logic so that when the Required Quantity is changed to *1*, the relationship between the parent Sales Order and its child Sales Orders is automatically removed.
This approach allows the current FDP business process to continue without any operational changes.
*Option 2*
Modify FDP to follow the same behavior as SC Production.
Once a Sales Order has been created:
* The *Required Quantity* becomes read-only.
* Users cannot modify the Required Quantity through Quote revisions.
* If a quantity change is required, users must create a new Quote and a new Sales Order.
Since this approach prevents data inconsistencies and aligns FDP with the standard SC business process, *we recommend Option 2*.
Before proceeding with the implementation, we would like to confirm the expected business process.
Could you please confirm whether FDP should follow the same behavior as SC Production by making the *Required Quantity* field non-editable after a Sales Order has been created?
 
Please find the attached document for your reference.
We look forward to your confirmation.
Best Regards,

As a result of our investigation, we have confirmed that this issue occurs because FDP has a specification that allows you to change the *number of units negotiated* in the estimate even after an order is created.

If you wish to change the number of units negotiated, you will need to create a new quotation and order.

Dear Tsunoda-San,
 
いつもお世話になっております。
 
はい、FDPで「商談台数」項目を編集不可とすることによる影響について検討いたしました。
 
想定している仕様は以下の通りです。
 
対象の見積から受注（Sales Order）が作成された後、「商談台数」項目は編集不可となります。

Yes, we have considered the impact of making the *Required Quantity* field non-editable in FDP.
 
The proposed behaviour is as follows:
# The *Required Quantity* field will become *read-only only after a Sales Order has been created* for the corresponding Quote.
# Until a Sales Order is created, users will continue to be able to modify the *Required Quantity* through the Quote as they do today.
# If, after Sales Order creation, the user needs to *decrease the required quantity*, the user can cancel the unnecessary child Sales Orders and proceed with Sales Posting using the remaining Sales Order, if required.

investigation_report.investigation_summary: In FDP, a Quote's Required Quantity could be changed from 3 to 1 after a Sales Order and three child Sales Orders had been created. Although the child Sales Orders were cancelled, the backend retained their linkage to the parent Sales Order, causing Sales Posting to fail. The recommended remediation was to align FDP with SC Production by making Required Quantity read-only after Sales Order creation; PROD deployment was requested, but completion is not documented.
important_findings: A Required Quantity of 3 created three child Sales Orders during Sales Order approval.
After a Quote revision changed Required Quantity from 3 to 1, added options were synchronized to all existing child Sales Orders.
Cancelling all child Sales Orders did not remove their backend association with the parent Sales Order, so Sales Posting failed.
FDP allowed Required Quantity changes after Sales Order creation, enabling the failing scenario.
The proposed FDP behavior is to make Required Quantity read-only after Sales Order creation, matching SC Production.
For post-order quantity increases, the proposed process requires cancelling the current Sales Order and creating a new Quote and Sales Order.
investigation_report.root_cause: FDP allowed Required Quantity to be reduced after Sales Order creation, but the backend logic did not automatically unlink existing child Sales Orders from the parent Sales Order when Required Quantity became 1.

BI Publisher再起動対応】
定期的なサービス再起動作業の実施時に、BI Publisherサービスが正常に起動できない事象が発生しました。
調査の結果、一部のBI Publisher関連ディレクトリにおいて権限設定の問題が発生しており、ログファイルが正常に出力されない状態となっていたことを確認しました。その影響により、BI Publisherサービスの起動処理が正常に完了せず、断続的な障害が発生していました。
ディレクトリの権限不整合が、サービス起動失敗およびシステム不安定化の主な原因であると判断しました。
6月21日に、影響を受けていたディレクトリに対して所有者およびアクセス権限の修正を実施し、BI Publisherサービスが正常に動作できる状態へ復旧しました。
修正後の監視結果では、システムの安定性が改善され、BI Publisher関連の障害発生件数が大幅に減少していることを確認しております。
また、恒久対応の一環として、6月22日 21:00以降に計画的なBI Publisher再起動を実施しました。本作業の目的は、修正後の権限設定が正常に反映されていることの確認、アプリケーションキャッシュのクリア、および残存していた異常プロセスの解消です。
再起動作業は問題なく完了し、キャッシュのクリアおよび全BI Publisherサービスの正常起動を確認しました。
さらに、6月23日の運用監視においても、権限に起因する起動障害は発生しておらず、システムが安定して稼働していることを確認しております。
問題なければ、本件をクローズしてもよろしいでしょうか
よろしくお願いいたします。
マニシャ

thank you always.
Regarding this matter, we have shared RCA via email, but we will also share it with JIRA.
BI Publisher restart support]
An issue occurred where the BI Publisher service could not be started normally when performing periodic service restart tasks.
As a result of our investigation, we confirmed that there was a permission setting issue in some BI Publisher-related directories, causing log files to not be output correctly. As a result, the BI Publisher service startup process was not completed successfully, causing intermittent failures.
We determined that directory permission mismatches were the primary cause of service startup failures and system instability.
On June 21st, we corrected the ownership and access permissions of the affected directories, and the BI Publisher service was restored to normal operation.
Monitoring results after the fix have confirmed that system stability has been improved and the number of BI Publisher-related failures has decreased significantly.
Additionally, as part of our permanent response, we conducted a planned restart of BI Publisher after 21:00 on June 22nd. The purpose of this work is to confirm that the modified permission settings are reflected correctly, clear the application cache, and eliminate any remaining abnormal processes.
The restart process was completed without any problems, and we confirmed that the cache was cleared and all BI Publisher services started correctly.
Furthermore, during operational monitoring on June 23, we confirmed that there were no startup failures due to privileges, and the system was operating stably.
If there is no problem, may I close this matter?
Thank you for your support.
Manisha

investigation_report.investigation_summary: Users could not generate the NV Sales Order Sheet BIP Report for SO# A000497806 in Shikoku Production. Code-level investigation identified a blank Tax Rate caused by an invalid Planned Delivery Date of 2007/03/30 in the related NV Sales Quote, rather than the initially suspected BI Publisher server issue. A corrected validation fix was tested in FDP UAT-1 and released to all FDP-PRODs on July 10.
important_findings: The affected SO# A000497806 could not generate the BIP Report because the Tax Rate on the NV Sales Order was blank.
The Tax Rate is calculated from the Planned Delivery Date in the corresponding NV Sales Quote.
The affected NV Sales Quote contained Planned Delivery Date 2007/03/30, preventing the system from deriving a valid Tax Rate.
NV Opportunity already prevented entry of dates earlier than the current date, but NV Sales Quote did not have equivalent validation.
The initial planned validation affected post-sales quote revisions; the fix was corrected after UAT feedback that errors appeared outside Rev1.
The corrected fix was implemented in FDP UAT-1 using NV Quote# 1-8GNWTU and then released to all FDP-PRODs.
investigation_report.root_cause: An invalid Planned Delivery Date of 2007/03/30 in the NV Sales Quote caused the Tax Rate for NV Sales Order SO# A000497806 to remain blank, resulting in NV Sales Order Sheet BIP Report generation failure.
investigation_report.resolution: A corrected Planned Delivery Date validation fix for NV Sales Quote was tested in FDP UAT-1 and released to all FDP-PRODs on July 10 to prevent invalid date input and resulting blank Tax Rate values.

investigation_report.investigation_summary: The reported issue was that SC FDP no longer automatically displayed the Full Model Code 2 value, which users stated had been populated automatically since FORCE began operating and from version 1.0. Initial investigation incorrectly identified the field as manual-entry behavior based on the SC version. Further assessment determined that restoring or changing the behavior requires modification of an ODI package; impact analysis and implementation planning were still in progress.
important_findings: Users reported that Full Model Code 2 had been automatically displayed since the start of FORCE and version 1.0.
SC FDP currently does not automatically display Full Model Code 2, and the field was observed as manually entered in the SC version.
The issue was reported as a regression/defect because the previously automatic display is no longer present.
A correction requires modification of the ODI package.
Impact assessment, feasibility review, and implementation planning were ongoing; no completion date or confirmed fix was provided.

investigation_report.investigation_summary: The incident involved a Vehicle Master Model Difference where a vehicle's Model Code differed from the expected value. Recovery for the affected record was completed. Testing in FDP UAT-1 confirmed that the Model Code can be manually edited from the Administration - Vehicle screen, but no evidence was available to prove that a user made the change in the affected record; the customer considered the root cause unresolved.
important_findings: The affected record was recovered.
In FDP UAT-1, VIN# FBA20-610547 initially had Model Code FBA20B22S00F and was manually changed to AA273KANR7Z through the Administration - Vehicle screen.
The Administration - Vehicle screen permits editing of the Model Code for responsibilities that require updates; other responsibilities were configured as read-only.
Multiple UAT test cases confirmed that Model Code displayed the correct value corresponding to the vehicle.
The investigation reported that Model Code changes are possible only through screen-based user operation and that Siebel processes were operating normally.
No audit evidence of a manual update to the affected record could be produced because subsequent business processing had already occurred.

Dear Tsunoda-San
いつもお世話になっております。
見積の最新改訂版が受注に反映されない事象（MFTBCFFR-5858）について、調査結果をご報告いたします。
 
|インシデント番号|MFTBCFFR-5858|
|事象内容|見積の最新改訂版が受注に反映されない|
|RCA|調査の結果、対象の受注は見積改訂版8までは正常に同期されていましたが、それ以降の改訂版については同期処理が停止していたことを確認いたしました。
NV見積をRev.8からRev.9へ同期するタイミングで、ユーザーが同じ受注に対して請求書作成（Invoice#：C000105274）を実施していました。
その結果、バックエンドで以下のエラーが発生し、同期処理が停止しました。
"ステップ 'Sync Sales Order' のサービス 'EAI Siebel Adapter'、 メソッド 'Synchronize' を実行中にエラーが発生しました。(SBL-BPR-00162)
--
ビジネスコンポーネント 'MF RF Order Entry - Line Items' (統合コンポーネント 'MF Order Item') のメソッド 'WriteRecord' で、検索条件が '= "47"' のレコードが次のエラーを返しました : "選択されたデータは、取得後に他のユーザにより変更されました。そのまま続けてください。(SBL-DAT-00523)"(SBL-EAI-04451)"
 
エラーメッセージ内の「Line Number = 47」に該当する明細は、部品番号「YN5Z」のリサイクル料金明細です。
見積Rev.9の同期処理と請求書作成処理が同時に実行された際、このリサイクル料金明細は請求書作成処理でも使用されていたため、同一レコードに対する同時更新が発生しました。
その結果、Siebelの排他制御により同期処理が停止したものと判断しております。|
|リカバリー状況|対象レコードについてはリカバリー対応を完了しております。|
|修正プラン|バックエンドログには、「レコードが他のユーザーによって同時に更新された」ことが明確に記録されています。
本事象は、同一レコードに対して複数の処理が同時に実行されたことにより発生した非常に稀なケースとなります。
現在は正常に動作しており、UAT環境でも同様の動作確認が可能です。
システム不具合ではないため、現時点でプログラム修正は不要と判断しております。|
以上となります。
ご不明な点がございましたら、お知らせください。

Dear Tsunoda-San
Thank you for your continued support.
We would like to report the results of our investigation regarding the issue of the latest revised estimate not being reflected in orders (MFTBCFFR-5858).
 
|Incident number|MFTBCFFR-5858|
|Event details|The latest revised version of the quotation is not reflected in the order|
|RCA|As a result of our investigation, we have confirmed that the affected orders were successfully synchronized up to quotation revision version 8, but the synchronization process had stopped for subsequent revisions.
At the time of synchronizing the NV quotation from Rev.8 to Rev.9, a user was creating an invoice (Invoice#: C000105274) for the same order.
As a result, the following error occurred on the backend and the synchronization process stopped.
"An error occurred while executing service 'EAI Siebel Adapter', method 'Synchronize' in step 'Sync Sales Order'. (SBL-BPR-00162)
--
In method 'WriteRecord' of business component 'MF RF Order Entry - Line Items' (integration component 'MF Order Item'), records with search criteria '= "47"' returned the following error: "The selected data has been modified by another user since it was retrieved. Please continue. (SBL-DAT-00523)"(SBL-EAI-04451)"
 
The item corresponding to "Line Number = 47" in the error message is the recycling fee item for part number "YN5Z".
When the estimate Rev. 9 synchronization process and the invoice creation process were executed at the same time, this recycling charge detail was also used in the invoice creation process, resulting in simultaneous updates to the same record.
As a result, we have determined that the synchronization process has stopped due to Siebel's exclusive control. |
|Recovery Status|Recovery has been completed for the target record. |
|Fix Plan|The backend logs clearly record that "the record was updated by other users at the same time."
This event is an extremely rare case that occurs due to multiple processes being executed simultaneously on the same record.
It is currently working properly, and the same operation can be confirmed in the UAT environment.
Since this is not a system defect, we have determined that no program correction is necessary at this time. |
That's all.
If you have any questions, please let us know.
 
Thank you for your support.

investigation_report.investigation_summary: The Sales Order synchronized successfully through NV Quote revision 8, but synchronization from revision 8 to revision 9 stopped. Concurrent invoice creation for the same NV Sale Order caused simultaneous modification of the Recycle Fee line item, triggering Siebel exclusive-control errors. Recovery was completed for the affected record; no program fix was required.
important_findings: The affected Sales Order was synchronized through quote revision 8; synchronization stopped when processing NV Quote revision 9.
Invoice C000105274 was created for the same NV Sale Order while the Rev.9 Sales Order synchronization was running.
The concurrent operations modified the same Recycle Fee line item, Line Number = 47, Part# YN5Z.
The Sync Sales Order step failed in EAI Siebel Adapter Synchronize with SBL-BPR-00162, SBL-DAT-00523, and SBL-EAI-04451.
Recovery was completed for the affected record, and the process subsequently operated normally, including in UAT.
investigation_report.root_cause: Concurrent quote-to-Sales Order synchronization and invoice creation updated the same Recycle Fee line item (Line Number = 47, Part# YN5Z), causing Siebel exclusive control to reject the synchronization update.
investigation_report.resolution: Recovered the affected record. No program correction was required because the incident was a rare concurrent-update scenario and the process was functioning normally afterward.

investigation_report.investigation_summary: Recycle Invoice DT27 processing created incorrect Journal Voucher values, initially affecting Segment2 Code fields and later Posting Date and client-code fields. The investigation identified chassis-number derivation/mapping issues, DT27 file formatting sensitivity, and UAT8 mapping differences from Chugoku prod and other FDP UATs. The corrected UAT logic was verified with test data, and the fix was scheduled for the 2026-07-23 FDP release.
important_findings: The calculation and reconciliation process formed the chassis number using "Stamp Code-C#", rather than the chassis-number position highlighted in the DT27 file.
Incorrect Segment2 Code(CSJS210) and Segment2 Code(CSJS310) values were initially associated with data received from TOB, including "********************" values in the DT27 Recycle Invoice file.
An extra space in the DT27 file caused amount value 80 to be treated as 8 during JV creation.
Client Code(CSJS208) and Client Code(CSJS308) mappings in UAT-8 differed from Chugoku prod and other FDP UATs, resulting in incorrect Recycle Invoice JV data.
UAT8 master data also caused client-code issues and was updated to match Chugoku prod.
After mapping updates, test data verified that JVs were created correctly with the correct Posting Date(CSJS005) and client-code values.
investigation_report.root_cause: UAT-8 mappings for Client Code(CSJS208) and Client Code(CSJS308) differed from Chugoku prod and other FDP UATs, causing incorrect Recycle Invoice Journal Voucher data. DT27 input formatting, including an extra space that converted 80 to 8, also caused an incorrect JV amount during testing.
investigation_report.resolution: Updated UAT-8 mappings and master data based on Chugoku prod and other FDP UATs, corrected DT27 test-file formatting, and verified correct Journal Voucher creation with new test data. The approved fix was scheduled for the 2026-07-23 FDP release.

comments.text:
Dear Hata san,
Thank you for your support.
As per our analysis, we found that these materials were received through the D2S_MATERIAL_MASTER file. Whenever a material is updated through the material master, the corresponding product is released by a batch job scheduled at 02:50 AM. In cases where a high count of materials is received, the product release process may take longer than usual to complete. Since the Price Master creation job is scheduled at 04:30 AM, there can be instances where the price creation process starts before the product release has been completed. This overlap results in an error similar to the one observed in this case: "Issue While Updating/Inserting Price Master with Product Name: MK718834". The issue occurs specifically when the material does not have any existing price record in the Price Master.
To prevent this timing overlap, we plan to reschedule the Price Master creation job from 04:30 AM to 05:00 AM. The subsequent related batch jobs will also be shifted by 30 minutes to maintain the existing processing sequence and synchronization between the price creation processes.

investigation_report.investigation_summary: Price Master creation failed for newly received materials in Wakayama and Okinawa - PROD because the Price Master job could start before batch product release completed. Materials arrived through the D2S_MATERIAL_MASTER file, and high material volumes extended the product-release processing time. Realtime job schedules were shifted by 30 minutes on all FDP environments, and successful price uploads were verified in all FDP-PROD environments.
important_findings: Materials were received through the D2S_MATERIAL_MASTER file.
A batch job scheduled at 02:50 AM releases products after Material Master updates.
High volumes of received materials can delay completion of the product-release process.
The Price Master creation job was scheduled at 04:30 AM and could overlap with incomplete product release.
The error "Issue While Updating/Inserting Price Master with Product Name: MK718834" occurred when the material had no existing Price Master record.
Realtime jobs were delayed by 30 minutes, and price uploads subsequently succeeded on all FDP-PROD environments.
investigation_report.root_cause: The Price Master creation job started before the batch product-release process completed for high-volume Material Master updates, causing Price Master insert/update errors for materials without existing price records.
investigation_report.resolution: Increased scheduled timings of the Realtime jobs by 30 minutes on all FDP environments, shifting Price Master creation and related batch jobs to prevent overlap; verified successful price uploads on all FDP-PROD environments.

Thank you for your support.
We analysed this issue and identified that, for the three affected materials, the Product Release batch was not completed successfully. Due to this, the Realtime Price Master process was halted for those materials.
During the final step of the Realtime Price batch execution, the process validates whether the material exists in the master data for execution. Since the materials were not released successfully, the Realtime batch treated them as invalid entries.
The affected records have now been recovered in the production environment, and the materials have been successfully released to prevent any further issues. This is a rare occurrence where the product is not released and stuck.
Please allow us to close this incident since no fix is required on Siebel.
Kindly let us know in case of any queries.

The Realtime Price batch validation treated the unreleased materials as invalid master-data entries. The affected production records were recovered and the materials were successfully released; no Siebel fix was required.
important_findings: Recovery was completed for all affected FDP-Production records.
The Product Release batch did not complete successfully for three affected materials.
The final Realtime Price batch step validates whether each material exists in master data for execution.
Because the materials were not successfully released, the Realtime Price Master process treated them as invalid entries and halted.
The materials were released successfully in the production environment after recovery.
investigation_report.root_cause: The Product Release batch was not completed successfully for three materials, leaving the products unreleased and causing the Realtime Price Master process to reject them as invalid master-data entries.
investigation_report.resolution: Recovered the affected records in the production environment and successfully released the three materials. No Siebel fix was required.

Thank you for your support.
I have checked this issue and found that “Sales Posting Body Non IBOS“ and “Sales Posting Body Non IBOS GI“ JVs were not created for above mentioned Body orders due to following reasons:
1. Before Sales Posting of Sales Order, NV quote was revised and Body Line Line Items were added and synced to SO but PO was not created for all line items from 'Body' tab in Line Items of SO.
2. Once these line items were synced, invoicing and sales posting was done. After sales posting completion, “*Sales Posting*”* JVs were created for the Sales Order and POs mapped to it.
3. After Sales Posting, PO was created from body of line details for remaining body items.
Since Sales Posting was already completed , that is why GI JV was not created for these line items. As per current functionality, once Sales Posting is completed, then PO is created then JV is created for delta values with Journal event type like *“Revise Sales Posting*“*.
*UAT1 Test Record:* A001304611, B001304616
*Fix Plan:* We can add validation on sales posting to create PO for all body line items present in current sakes order before proceeding with Sales Posting of the Sales Order.
*Recovery Plan:* Recovery for Orders mentioned in the description of this Jira has already been completed. We are working on finding affected records for other FDPs as well and will share it with you by {{2026-05-26}} end of the day.
Please review the recovery plan and fix plan and let us know in case of any queries.
Regards,
Atul Yadav

investigation_report.investigation_summary: “Sales Posting Body Non IBOS” and “Sales Posting Body Non IBOS GI” JVs were missing for Body orders because POs for newly added Body line items were created only after Sales Posting had completed. Recovery was completed for the orders listed in the Jira, and additional records with POs created after Sales Posting were identified for review. The current system cannot create the requested Body GI JV after Sales Posting; a permanent enhancement requires new Body Building Order logic and must be handled through PJ-CR.
important_findings: An NV Quotation revision added Body line items and synchronized them to the Sales Order, but POs were not created for all Body-tab line items before Sales Posting.
Sales Posting created JVs only for the Sales Order and POs mapped at the time of Sales Posting; remaining POs were created afterward.
“Sales Posting Body GI” and “Sales Posting Body” JVs are created only during Sales Order Sales Posting and are not generated retrospectively for POs created afterward.
The existing “Revised Sales Posting” Journal Event Type creates delta-value JVs for post-Sales-Posting PO creation, but does not provide the requested Body GI JV behavior.
Supporting post-Sales-Posting creation of Body GI JVs requires changes to multiple objects and testing of Body Building Order processes and related interfaces.
Recovery was completed for the Jira-listed orders, and records with POs created after Sales Posting were shared for review.
investigation_report.root_cause: POs for Body line items added through an NV Quotation revision were not created before Sales Posting. When the remaining POs were created after Sales Posting, the system did not create “Sales Posting Body Non IBOS GI” JVs because those JVs are generated only at Sales Order Sales Posting.
investigation_report.resolution: Recovery was completed for the affected orders listed in the Jira using recovery JV data linked to KB in the nightly daily batch. A permanent post-Sales-Posting Body GI JV enhancement remains pending and requires PJ-CR.

Dear Shiromoto-San,
Thank you for your support.
*Root Cause:*
We investigated this issue and found that, for Cancellation Requests, the approval flow *"UV Purchase Order Cancel UV Mgr Approval Request"* is triggered. In this approval flow, only *SCHQ-Sales-UV-Mgr* is configured as the approver position.
We could not find any user in Wakayama assigned to this position. As a result, when *Generate Approval* is clicked, the *Approvers* field remains blank in the Approval History. Therefore, according to the CR-4196 change, when the Approver field is blank, validation is triggered and the history record gets deleted.
We checked all Cancellation Requests in the Wakayama production environment and found that the Approver is null for all requests. We also tried to replicate this issue in UAT, and it is working correctly there.
Therefore, this is not a bug, but an issue caused by the absence of a user assigned to the *SCHQ-Sales-UV-Mgr* position.
*Recovery Plan:*
# Assign the *SCHQ-Sales-UV-Mgr* position to a user and ask the user to click *Generate Approval* again.
# Since the status in the Cancellation Request is editable, the user can proceed by changing the status to *"Approved"* manually.
# We can retrigger the process from the backend and approve the request.
Please let us know which recovery method you would like us to proceed with. Kindly let us know if you have any questions.
Regards,
Atul Yadav

investigation_report.investigation_summary: Journal Voucher Department Code mapping used different branch sources when the Job Card (JC) creator and Job Card Order (JCO) creator differed. The initial UAT fix changed Credit Department Code (CSJS300) to the JC Creation Branch for three Job Card Sales journal voucher types. Subsequent validation found that Job Card - Labor cost JVs still used the JCO Creation Branch, and confirmation was requested on extending the JC Creation Branch mapping to all Job Card Journal Voucher types.
important_findings: For Job Card Sales Amount Taxable, Job Card Sales Amount CT, and Job Card Sales Amount Non-Taxable, Responsible Service Shop Code was mapped to Debit Department Code (CSJS200) and Branch Code was mapped to Credit Department Code (CSJS300).
The original issue occurred because Debit and Credit Department Codes could use different sources: JC workshop/shop code for debit and JCO creator Branch Code for credit.
UAT changed CSJS300 in JV to use the JC creator's Branch Code; test record I001305002 had JCO Creator 40 and JC Creator 20.
For JC I001305241, Job Card Sales correctly set CSJS200 and CSJS300 to JC Creation Branch 10, while Job Card - Labor set both codes to JCO Creation Branch 40.
The remaining incorrect mapping was suspected to be in the cost JV creation section.
A decision was still pending on whether CSJS200 and CSJS300 should use JC Creation Branch Code for all Job Card Journal Voucher types.
investigation_report.root_cause: Department Code mapping was only corrected for the three Job Card Sales journal voucher types, while Job Card - Labor cost JV creation continued to use the JCO Creation Branch instead of the JC Creation Branch.

Dear Tsunoda-San,
いつもお世話になっております。 
GI JVが作成されなかった対象のシャーシオーダー（B000062227、B000062228、B000062229、B000001569）について調査した結果をご報告いたします。 
調査の結果、GI JVが作成されなかった原因は、「型式コード（Model Code）」の価格が登録されていなかったためであることを確認いたしました。
対象のシャーシオーダーが作成された時点で、価格マスタ（Price List）に該当する型式コードの価格情報が存在していませんでした。 そのため、GR JV作成時には、オプションやカラーなど価格が登録されている明細のみが対象となり、型式コードの金額は含まれておりませんでした。 
その後、売上計上（Sales Posting）が実施されましたが、型式コードに価格が設定されていなかったため、GI JVは作成されませんでした。 
【原因】 
シャーシオーダー作成時に、対象の型式コードの価格情報が価格マスタに登録されていなかったことが原因です。 
【対応方針】 
本件はSiebelの不具合ではなく、システムは正常に動作しております。そのため、システム改修は不要と判断しております。 
ご不明な点がございましたらお知らせください。 
よろしくお願いいたします。

We would like to share the results of our investigation regarding the affected Chassis Orders (B000062227, B000062228, B000062229, and B000001569) for which the GI JV was not created.

When these Chassis Orders were created, the Price List did not contain pricing information for the affected Model Code. As a result, during GR JV creation, only the amounts for line items with valid prices, such as Options and Colors, were included. The Model Code amount was not included in the GR JV calculation.
Subsequently, when Sales Posting was performed for the related Sales Orders, the GI JV could not be created because the Model Code line item still did not have a valid price.
Root Cause
The required pricing information for the affected Model Code was not maintained in the Price Master List at the time the Chassis Orders were created.

This is not a Siebel system defect. The system is functioning as designed, and therefore no system modification is required for this case.

investigation_report.investigation_summary: The incident concerned Chassis GI JV records not being created despite GR JV creation for selected orders. Initial analysis attributed missing GI JVs for several chassis orders to absent Model Code pricing in the Price Master/Price List, but the issue was subsequently addressed in UAT by updating the GI JV filter condition. After the change, Chassis GI JV creation was confirmed for test records A001304859 and B001258096.
important_findings: GI JV was not created for orders B000121443, B000062227, B000062228, B000062229, and B000001569, while other reviewed records were reported as correct.
For B000062227, B000062228, B000062229, and B000001569, the Model Code had no price in the Price Master/Price List when the Chassis Orders were created.
Without Model Code pricing, GR JV included only priced items such as Options and Colors; the Model Code amount was excluded.
A GI JV filter condition was updated in UAT, after which Chassis GI JV was created correctly for test records A001304859 and B001258096.
The reported concern was that GI was not created despite GR being present.
investigation_report.root_cause: The GI JV filter condition required correction; updating this condition in UAT enabled Chassis GI JV creation.
investigation_report.resolution: Updated the filter condition in GI JV in UAT and verified correct Chassis GI JV creation using test records A001304859 and B001258096.

Recovery Status: 
The recovery is completed for all the mentioned parts.
RCA: 
The issue was identified to be related to the ODI job execution process after the FDP release activity. Due to the ODI Agent not functioning properly, the scheduled ODI package executions failed during the processing window. As a result, the Price Master related jobs were not executed successfully, which led to the corresponding price records not being created in all the FDPs. Upon identification of the issue, the ODI Agent service was restored, and the failed ODI packages were re-executed successfully, after which the pending price data was created and validated successfully. 
Countermeasure:
Necessary monitoring has been implemented, and checks will be performed post release to ensure stable execution of subsequent jobs and to prevent recurrence of similar issues.
Please let us know in case of any query.
Best Regards,
Soham Modi

investigation_report.investigation_summary: A Parts Return Order processed after JC closure caused Quote and JCO amounts to differ, creating a risk of incorrect invoice amounts. Standard behavior requires creating a new Quote and completing Customer Approved after a return order; otherwise JC closing should show "Please synchronize the quote first." The originally reported bypass of this validation could not be consistently reproduced in UAT, logs, or database checks. Preventive validations and post-closure return-order restrictions were implemented in UAT-1 and scheduled for release to FDP-PROD.
important_findings: A completed Parts Return Order does not automatically synchronize updated return amounts to an existing JCO.
After a return order, a new Quote must be created and Customer Approved to synchronize the latest amounts between Quote and JCO.
If the required Quote recreation and approval are not performed, JC closing is expected to display "Please synchronize the quote first."
The reported case proceeded without the expected synchronization validation, but the behavior could not be consistently reproduced through UAT scenarios, log review, or database verification.
The implemented validation compares Quote and JCO Parts/Oil and Labor totals and blocks processing when values differ.
The Create Parts Return Order button was disabled for closed JCs to prevent return orders after JC closure.
investigation_report.resolution: Implemented in UAT-1: error pop-ups for mismatches between Quote and JCO Parts/Oil List Price Total, Discount Total, Sales Price Total, and Labor List Price Total, Discount Total, Sales Price Total; disabled Create Parts Return Order when the JC is Closed. Deployment to FDP-PROD was requested and scheduled for the 2026-07-23 release.

Quote and JCO Order Labor totals are not the same. Kindly sync quote to continue.
